Package com.egradx.auth.security

Interface EgradxAttemptLimiter

All Known Implementing Classes:
EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter, EgradxRedisAttemptLimiter
public interface EgradxAttemptLimiter
Limits password guesses. egradx-auth asks before checking a password, and reports how the check went; an application can replace the in-memory default (EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter) with one that counts somewhere shared, such as Redis, so that several instances count together.

key names what is being guessed at — login:<identifier as typed> or password:<user id> — and clientAddress where from; it is null outside an HTTP request. A limiter must never limit a key on its own, only a key from one address and an address across keys: a limit on the key alone would let anyone lock its owner out.
